components.title: Acme Health Patient Intake API — GRC baseline
components.description: Terraform GRC baseline wrapping the cgep-app-starter Patient Intake API (Lambda + API Gateway + DynamoDB + S3). Closes six of the starter's eight named compliance gaps: customer-managed KMS encryption on the PHI data stores, TLS-only bucket policy, S3 versioning, private-VPC Lambda placement with no internet egress, and least-privilege IAM. Source: terraform/kms.tf, terraform/s3_uploads_hardening.tf, terraform/dynamodb_hardening_override.tf, terraform/main_override.tf, terraform/vpc_endpoints.tf, terraform/lambda_security_group.tf.
components.purpose: Make the starter's Patient Intake API audit-defensible against CMMC Level 2 without modifying the workload itself.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 controls satisfied by this Terraform baseline (CMMC Level 2 declared primary framework). Evidence is captured and signed by the grc-gate GitHub Actions workflow on every merge to main and uploaded to the evidence vault under S3 Object Lock, COMPLIANCE mode, 400-day retention.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-01: the starter's S3 uploads bucket relied on AWS-managed SSE-S3. aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration.uploads now enforces SSE-KMS against a customer-managed key (aws_kms_key.capstone), giving PHI key custody to the account rather than AWS. Gated in CI by Conftest namespace compliance.sc_13_11_s3_encryption.

links.text: Signed grc-gate pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json, plan.txt, and conftest-results.json. Retained under COMPLIANCE lock for 400 days.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-02: the starter's DynamoDB submissions table used the AWS-owned default key. A server_side_encryption block on aws_dynamodb_table.intake (added via a Terraform override file, since encryption is an attribute of the table resource itself, not a separate resource type) now points at the same customer-managed CMK as GAP-01. Gated in CI by Conftest namespace compliance.sc_13_11_dynamodb_encryption.

links.text: Signed grc-gate pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json, plan.txt, and conftest-results.json. Retained under COMPLIANCE lock for 400 days.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-03: the starter's uploads bucket had no policy denying non-TLS requests. aws_s3_bucket_policy.uploads_tls_only denies s3:* on the bucket and its objects when aws:SecureTransport is false. Gated in CI by Conftest namespace compliance.sc_13_8_tls_enforcement (existence-based check — see policies/sc_13_8_tls_enforcement.rego's own comment for why this policy verifies the resource exists rather than parsing the rendered policy JSON).

links.text: Signed grc-gate pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json, plan.txt, and conftest-results.json. Retained under COMPLIANCE lock for 400 days.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-04: the starter's uploads bucket had no versioning, so PHI overwrites were unrecoverable. aws_s3_bucket_versioning.uploads sets status Enabled. Mapped to 03.08.09 (System Backup - Cryptographic Protection, media-protection family) as the closest fit in the 800-171 Rev 3 control set: this is an interpretation, not a literal text match — versioning is treated here as S3's storage-native recovery mechanism for accidental overwrite, in the same family as backup protection, rather than a formal backup process. Gated in CI by Conftest namespace compliance.mp_3_8_9_versioning.

links.text: Signed grc-gate pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json, plan.txt, and conftest-results.json. Retained under COMPLIANCE lock for 400 days.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-05: the starter's Lambda ran in the default Lambda network, not the VPC it provisions. aws_lambda_function.intake now has a vpc_config placing it in both private subnets behind a security group whose only egress rule is scoped to the S3 and DynamoDB VPC gateway-endpoint prefix lists on port 443 - no NAT Gateway exists and no 0.0.0.0/0 route exists anywhere in the private route table, so the function has no internet egress path at all, not just a private IP. Gated in CI by Conftest namespace compliance.sc_13_1_vpc_boundary.

links.text: Signed grc-gate pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json, plan.txt, and conftest-results.json. Retained under COMPLIANCE lock for 400 days.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-07: the starter's Lambda execution role had dynamodb:* and s3:* on the workload's data stores. aws_iam_role_policy.lambda_inline now grants exactly dynamodb:PutItem, s3:PutObject (scoped to the uploads/ key prefix), and the two KMS actions the CMK requires - no wildcard action remains. Gated in CI by Conftest namespace compliance.ac_1_5_least_privilege, which parses the rendered policy JSON and fails on any "service:*" action.
